Skive is a Danish municipality evaluated in the Annual Report from the Atrial Fibrillation Database in Denmark for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of care for patients with atrial fibrillation, specifically focusing on anticoagulation treatment and safety monitoring across all 98 Danish municipalities to support local quality development and benchmarking [^src2]. 

In the context of Indikator 4b, which measures adherence to safety practices regarding the use of DOAC (Direct Oral Anticoagulant) medications, Skive demonstrated strong clinical performance [^src1]. The municipality achieved a compliance rate of 95.3% (1,010 out of 1,060 patients), successfully meeting and exceeding the national standard threshold of ≥95% [^src1]. 

Additionally, Skive's performance is detailed in the report's sections covering Indikator 1 (early initiation of anticoagulation therapy) and Indikator 5 (prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment) [^src2]. For these specific metrics, the municipality recorded figures of 4 out of 1,383 (0.3%) and 17 out of 1,396 (1.2%), reflecting its localized data within the broader national and regional breakdowns [^src2]. While Skive is not explicitly linked to other specific entities in the extracted dataset, its data serves as a vital component of the decentralized quality assurance framework managed by RKKP and the Atrial Fibrillation Database in Denmark.
